name: lunasec
description: LunaSec - Security & Compliance SDKs to stop data leaks in your software. By adding just a few lines of code anywhere you touch data, LunaSec adds a Zero Trust Architecture across your stack, Unique Per-Record Encryption, and protection from common security issues like XSS, SQL Injection, and RCE. Try it out live here: https://app.lunasec.dev
